# heraut commit

Commit message tooling.

Tools for Conventional Commits messages, the format heraut reads to pick the next version and fill
the changelog: check one message or a range of commits, check the ticket patterns, or write a message
step by step.

## Usage

```text
heraut commit [command]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut commit verify "feat(api): add pagination"
heraut commit check --from-latest-tag
heraut commit create
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |

## Subcommands

- [heraut commit check](heraut_commit_check.md): Validate every commit in a range (or full history) against the conventional-commit grammar
- [heraut commit create](heraut_commit_create.md): Interactively author a Conventional Commits message and commit it
- [heraut commit tickets](heraut_commit_tickets.md): Show the tickets your commits.tickets patterns find in a range of commits
- [heraut commit verify](heraut_commit_verify.md): Validate a commit message against the conventional-commit grammar
